meta_title: B & J Markham Garden Services | Gardener Leeds
meta_description: B & J Markham Garden Services in Leeds offers professional garden maintenance, landscaping, and design. Local family business serving Guiseley and surrounding areas.
hero_subhead: Transform your outdoor space with professional garden design, landscaping, and maintenance tailored to your home.
services_heading: Complete Garden Services Across Leeds & Guiseley
services_subhead: From routine maintenance to bespoke landscaping projects, we handle every aspect of garden care.

services.title: Garden Design & Landscaping
services.desc: Bespoke garden design that maximises your space and brings your vision to life. We handle everything from planning and groundworks to planting and finishing touches.

services.title: Regular Garden Maintenance
services.desc: Weekly, fortnightly, or monthly upkeep keeps your garden looking pristine. Lawn care, hedge trimming, weeding, and seasonal tidying all included.

services.title: Tree Lopping & Felling
services.desc: Safe, professional removal of unwanted trees and large branches. Fully insured, with debris cleared and chipped on site.

services.title: Patio & Decking Installation
services.desc: New patios, decking, and hard landscaping that withstands Yorkshire weather. Custom designs to match your home and budget.

services.title: Hedge & Shrub Pruning
services.desc: Precise cutting and shaping keeps hedges healthy and your garden boundaries neat. Waste removed and composted.

services.title: Garden Clearance & Tidy-Ups
services.desc: Overgrown gardens cleared, rubbish removed, and the space left ready for planting or redesign. Perfect for new builds or neglected plots.

about_pullquote: We treat every garden as if it were our own back yard.
about_para_1: B & J Markham Garden Services has served the Leeds and Guiseley community for over 20 years. Born from a passion for creating beautiful outdoor spaces, we've built a reputation for reliable, skilled work and a genuine care for our customers' gardens. Whether you need a spring tidy-up or a complete landscape transformation, our hands-on team delivers.
about_para_2: Customers trust us because we listen, we turn up on time, and we get the job done right the first time. We've transformed over a thousand gardens across North Leeds, and most of our work comes from word of mouth and repeat bookings. We're not just contractors — we're your neighbours who know how to make gardens thrive.
reviews_heading: What Leeds Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had my garden completely overgrown after moving in. B & J came out, gave me a honest quote, and transformed it into something really special. They cleared everything, laid a new patio, and replanted with lovely shrubs. The lads were tidy, professional, and didn't leave me out of pocket. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Been using them for monthly maintenance for three years now. Reliable, consistent, and they actually care about the plants. Our garden looks better than ever. Best £30 a month we spend.
reviews.author: Margaret P.

reviews.text: Called for an emergency tree removal after a branch came down in the storm. They came out next morning, assessed the risk safely, and felled it without damaging the fence or our neighbour's property. Professional job, fair price, waste all chipped and taken away.
reviews.author: Chris H.
